preamble: The voiceless sibilant [s] can become [l] by total assimilation to an adjacent lateral. In the prehistory of Latin, an *ls cluster is thought to have assimilated to ll, as in collum 'neck' from Proto-Italic *kʷolsom. Outside such clusters a direct [s] > [l] change is not documented, so the shift is rare and strictly conditioned.

examples.note: The cluster *ls assimilated to ll; the etymology is marked as uncertain in Wiktionary (cf. Proto-Germanic *halsaz 'neck').
